result.brief: 提出 DuoMatching 联合-边缘分布匹配框架，通过 LatentBridge 对齐视频学生与图像教师的潜空间，实现少步视频生成的质量与语义提升。
result.reason: Distribution matching distillation for few-step video generation; LatentBridge resolves latent representation mismatch between video student and image teacher, a representation-level contribution serving video generation.
